# Image/layout expansion corpus

Ordinary Cargo tests read the included fixtures and expected results offline.
QEMU, DiscUtils, libewf, TSK, Python and Apple's C codec are development oracles
only. Nothing in the production Rust library loads them.

`provenance.json` pins source commits and tool versions. `SHA256SUMS` hashes the
included bytes; `vhdx-reference.json` also records decoded stream hashes.

## Public captures

- Seven VHDX images are from `log2timeline/dfvfs/test_data`: ext2, FAT parent/
  differential, and NTFS fixed/dynamic/parent/differential. Their original bytes
  are gzip-packed with mtime zero. Base streams were independently exported by
  QEMU 2.3.0; differencing streams were exported by DiscUtils 0.16.13 with
  explicit matching parent objects. DiscUtils also independently exported all
  seven streams and matched those goldens. Parent images intentionally lack the
  user files that appear in the differencing images.
- `tracy-phone.L01` is the original
  `tracy-phone-2012-07-05-1640.L01`, an EnCase 7.2.4.2 capture from Digital
  Corpora's 2012 National Gallery DC scenario. The copy was obtained from
  `abrignoni/ewfprobe/tests/fixtures`; the original scenario is under
  `corpora/scenarios/2012-ngdc/extra/tracy-phone-encase/` at Digital Corpora.
  Digital Corpora publishes scenario data under CC0 except material within
  images that has its own copyright. Preserve this attribution when distributing
  the fixture. `l01-reference.json.gz` contains all 9,952 entries including the
  root: libewf 20130416 supplied sizes, child counts and content bytes; Python
  SHA-256 supplied independent hashes. Tests compare every entry, including
  directory-associated content, and verify available stored per-file hashes.

## Authored edge images

`tools/make_format_expansion.py` derives images from the existing public HFS,
APFS and UFS fixture corpus. Its original payloads supply the expected content;
expectations are not generated by the Rust parsers.

- UFS1b derivatives convert inode ownership/time fields, directory layouts and
  Solaris superblock version/state fields, in both byte orders. Native Solaris
  formatter output has not been tested. TSK's CLI has no UFS1b selector, its
  automatic BSD interpretation gives incorrect Solaris ownership and its old
  directory handling also differs by endian. These fields are checked against
  the primary illumos definitions and known authoring values, not copied from
  that incorrect interpretation. Content hashes come from the independently
  verified source BSD image.
- HFS wrappers contain the original HFS+/HFSX volume inside one extent. TSK
  independently opens them and returns the source trees/content. Ordinary and
  resource-fork metadata/content are compared with their source images.
- Compressed fixtures replace `/passwords.txt` using zlib, LZVN, raw or LZFSE
  decmpfs storage. Zlib uses Python's independent encoder; LZVN/LZFSE use the
  published Apple C encoder. Resource fixtures mix compressed/stored chunks and
  a final partial chunk. APFS additionally exercises nonresident compression
  attributes. `compression-source.json` hashes the original payloads. TSK
  matches zlib/LZVN files on both filesystems; its unavailable raw/LZFSE decoding
  is recorded in `tsk-reference.json` rather than treated as a Rust failure.
- The APFS snapshot derivative records XID 3 with the original file and XID 4
  with changed live content. Its current object map retains both root versions.
  TSK's ordinary extraction and `-S 3` match the two recorded hashes. This is a
  deliberately constructed read fixture, not a native Time Machine capture or
  a claim of complete APFS allocator/fsck consistency.
- Split L01 sets are independently authored Python wire-format fixtures.
  `logical-split` is independently enumerated/read by libewf, including byte-fill
  sparse and duplicate-offset content. `logical-multi` adds a noncontiguous
  extent mapping checked against original source bytes. The available 2013
  libewf rejects multi-extent offset values, so that one case is not claimed as
  independent-reader-validated. Both contain plain/compressed chunks, two
  segments, stored media MD5 and empty files.
- E01 wrappers were independently written by libewf (EnCase 6 writer profile,
  zlib level 2), with stored media MD5/SHA1. They wrap all new UFS/wrapper/
  snapshot/compression raw fixtures. The writer-profile label is not a claim of
  native EnCase output.

## Reproduction

Download the pinned public VHDX and L01 sources in `provenance.json` into
`target/format-expansion`. The fixture generator uses the existing
`tests/fixtures/layers` source images.

For codec authoring, download the pinned `lzfse/lzfse/src` reference files and
build a development-only DLL with GCC:

```powershell
gcc -shared -O2 -o target/format-expansion/apple-lzfse.dll target/format-expansion/lzfse_encode.c target/format-expansion/lzfse_encode_base.c target/format-expansion/lzvn_encode_base.c target/format-expansion/lzfse_fse.c target/format-expansion/lzfse_decode.c target/format-expansion/lzfse_decode_base.c target/format-expansion/lzvn_decode_base.c
python tools/make_format_expansion.py --ewf-library D:/Projects/autopsy/thirdparty/ewfexport_exec/64-bit/libewf.dll
python tools/validate_expansion_oracles.py --ewf-library D:/Projects/autopsy/thirdparty/ewfexport_exec/64-bit/libewf.dll --tsk-bin target/tsk-oracle/sleuthkit-4.15.0-win32/bin
```

The generator refuses a mismatch between an existing E01 wrapper and its source.
Regenerate a changed wrapper explicitly after reviewing why its source changed.

For VHDX, NuGet's DiscUtils.Core, DiscUtils.Streams and DiscUtils.Vhdx 0.16.13
netstandard2.0 assemblies go in `target/format-expansion/discutils`. Run:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -File tools/validate_vhdx_discutils.ps1
```

`tools/validate_expansion_oracles.py --write-reference` regenerates the real
L01 enumeration using libewf; otherwise it compares it with the included oracle.
Neither oracle script uses Rust results to construct expected content.

Primary format references:

- [Microsoft MS-VHDX](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-vhdx/83e061f8-f6e2-4de1-91bd-5d518a43d477)
- [libewf EWF format](https://github.com/libyal/libewf/blob/main/documentation/Expert%20Witness%20Compression%20Format%20%28EWF%29.asciidoc)
- [Apple HFS+ TN1150](https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/technotes/tn/tn1150.html)
- [Apple APFS reference](https://developer.apple.com/support/downloads/Apple-File-System-Reference.pdf)
- [illumos UFS superblock](https://github.com/illumos/illumos-gate/blob/master/usr/src/uts/common/sys/fs/ufs_fs.h) and [inode](https://github.com/illumos/illumos-gate/blob/master/usr/src/uts/common/sys/fs/ufs_inode.h)
- [Apple codec](https://github.com/lzfse/lzfse)

The native-derived fixture source attribution remains in
`tests/fixtures/LICENSE.dfvfs` and the existing layer corpus notes. Respect
upstream licenses when downloading/building independent development tools.
